title: Creating and Managing Preset Filters
summary: We’re excited to announce the new Preset Filters feature, designed to simplify your workflow. This enhancement allows users to create, save, and manage custom filter presets directly on the dispatch console, making it easier to toggle between frequently used filter settings. With just a few clicks, you can update and apply filters, streamlining your operations and saving valuable time.
body: Step 1: To create a new Preset Filter, Click the plus icon to add a new filter on the main dashboard. Step 2: Set all the relevant filters that you'd like to use. Step 3: Click the add button to apply the new preset filter. Step 4: If you make changes to the preset filter, you can simply click the save icon to update the selection for that filter. Step 5: You can toggle between the default view and saved Preset Filters by selecting them from the drop-down.
